BREAK.name: JDARMY BREAK
BREAK.title: Business Risk Enumeration & Avoidance Knowledge
BREAK.description: BREAK is an open knowledge framework for business risk enumeration and avoidance.

riskComplexityLevelDesc.basic: Basic: Low attack barrier, simple exploitation, no special resources or skills required.
riskComplexityLevelDesc.intermediate: Intermediate: Requires some technical capability or specific tools; attack path is relatively complex.
riskComplexityLevelDesc.advanced: Advanced: High attack complexity, requires expertise, custom tools, or multi-party coordination.

riskPriorityLevelDesc.P0: P0 (Critical): Highest priority, requires immediate remediation. High likelihood and business loss; mitigate within the shortest timeframe.
riskPriorityLevelDesc.P1: P1 (High): High priority, should be remediated with priority scheduling. Significant risk; develop a mitigation plan as soon as possible.
riskPriorityLevelDesc.P2: P2 (Medium): Medium priority, include in regular remediation scheduling. Risk is manageable; mitigate progressively per plan.
riskPriorityLevelDesc.P3: P3 (Low): Low priority, can be deferred. Low risk; address when resources permit.

semanticExplanation.riskAvoidance: Risk "{fromTitle}" lists avoidance "{toTitle}" as a direct mitigation or coverage option.
semanticExplanation.toolAvoidance: Attack tool "{fromTitle}" connects to avoidance "{toTitle}", meaning the measure can limit or counter the tool.
semanticExplanation.avoidance: "{fromTitle}" connects to avoidance "{toTitle}" with defensive or mitigation meaning.
semanticExplanation.directCauseRisk: "{fromTitle}" is recorded as directly causing risk "{toTitle}".
semanticExplanation.indirectSupportRisk: "{fromTitle}" is recorded as indirectly supporting or driving risk "{toTitle}".
semanticExplanation.riskPrerequisite: Risk "{toTitle}" is recorded as a prerequisite for risk "{fromTitle}".
semanticExplanation.riskCoOccurrence: Risk "{fromTitle}" commonly appears together with risk "{toTitle}".
semanticExplanation.riskVariant: Risk "{toTitle}" is a related or more specific variant of risk "{fromTitle}".
semanticExplanation.avoidancePrerequisite: Avoidance "{toTitle}" is usually a prerequisite control before applying "{fromTitle}".
semanticExplanation.avoidanceComplement: Avoidance "{fromTitle}" and "{toTitle}" can be combined to cover different defensive surfaces.
semanticExplanation.avoidanceAlternative: Avoidance "{toTitle}" can act as an alternative or peer control for "{fromTitle}".
semanticExplanation.avoidanceMitigatesGap: Avoidance "{toTitle}" helps cover limitations or gaps in "{fromTitle}".
semanticExplanation.attackToolPrerequisite: Attack tool "{toTitle}" is usually a base resource or prerequisite before using "{fromTitle}".
semanticExplanation.attackToolCoUsed: Attack tool "{fromTitle}" and "{toTitle}" are often used together in the same attack chain.
semanticExplanation.attackToolAlternative: Attack tool "{toTitle}" can act as an alternative or peer tool for "{fromTitle}".
semanticExplanation.attackToolCapabilityUpgrade: Attack tool "{toTitle}" extends or upgrades the capability of "{fromTitle}".
semanticExplanation.threatActorCoInvolved: Threat actor "{fromTitle}" and "{toTitle}" share many risk or attack-tool connections, making them adjacent actor-profile clues for review.
semanticExplanation.buildAttackTool: Threat actor "{fromTitle}" has the capability to build or maintain attack tool "{toTitle}".
semanticExplanation.useAttackTool: Threat actor "{fromTitle}" uses attack tool "{toTitle}" in related activity.
semanticExplanation.causeRisk: "{fromTitle}" reaches "{toTitle}" through risk-causation fields; use the source fields to distinguish direct and indirect links.
semanticExplanation.relatedTerm: Term "{fromTitle}" lists "{toTitle}" as related knowledge for semantic context.
semanticExplanation.subEntity: "{toTitle}" is a child entry under "{fromTitle}", derived from the entity ID hierarchy.
semanticExplanation.attackToolMaker: Attack tool "{fromTitle}" can be traced back to builder "{toTitle}".
semanticExplanation.review: The relation "{relation}" between "{fromTitle}" and "{toTitle}" is not classified yet and needs review.

relationImpact.attackToolRelation: Use this to identify prerequisite, co-use, alternative, and capability-upgrade relations between attack tools.
relationImpact.threatActorRelation: Use this to identify adjacent threat actors with many shared risk or tool connections.
relationImpact.threatActorTool: Use this to identify actor capabilities and tool usage.
relationImpact.causeRisk: Check the source fields to distinguish direct and indirect relations.
relationImpact.relatedTerm: This explains terminology context and is not attack causality.
relationImpact.subEntity: This expands finer-grained entities and is not a standalone attack step.
relationImpact.review: Add source or relationship semantics during data maintenance.
